title: Track something new
brief: Your project already has one commit, and a brand new notes.txt just appeared. Git ignores untracked files until you add them. Track it and commit.

goals.label: A commit with the message "add notes" exists

diagnostics.say: notes.txt is still untracked. git status shows it; git add notes.txt moves it into the index, then commit.

hints: git status lists notes.txt under untracked files.
git add notes.txt, then git commit -m "add notes".
